senses.gloss: m. (v. טָפַס; cmp. דָּפוּס, טָפוּס) frame; trnsf. (influenced by Greek τύπος) formula (to be filled out according to occasion).
units: Y. Ber. I, 3ᵈ ט׳ ברכות וכ׳ such is the formula of the benedictions; Lev. R. s. 34, end; Y. Sabb. XV, end, 15ᵇ טופוס.—Esp. the formula or blank of documents, opp. תורף containing names, dates &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 3:1:3">Y. Gitt. III, beg. 44ᶜ</cite> <he>כתב תרפו בט׳</he> (also <he>בתוֹפֵס</he>) if the writer filled out a blank.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 7b:13">B. Mets. 7ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>טוֹפְסִין</he>, constr. <he>טוֹפְסֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 2:1:2">Y. Gitt. II, beg. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>פוסל בט׳</he> declares illegal deeds of divorce written into ready-made blanks.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 3:2">Gitt. III, 2</cite> <he>הכותב ט׳ גיטין וכ׳</he> he who writes formulas of letters of divorce must leave blanks for the name &c.; a. fr.
